intro: For day-to-day updates — cancellations, last-minute events, photos from the night before — follow the club on Facebook. This blog is for the bigger, standing news.

posts.title: Easter Bingo Night
posts.excerpt: A full house for our Easter bingo night, with a table of raffle prizes up for grabs.
posts.body: Another great turnout for our Easter bingo night, with the room packed out and a strong table of raffle prizes on offer. See the photo in the gallery above.

posts.title: Happy Hour — every Friday, 4 to 6pm
posts.excerpt: Good drinks, great company. New weekly Happy Hour starts this Friday.
posts.body: Dear members, just to let you all know that we're now running a Happy Hour from 4–6pm every Friday. Good drinks, great company — all welcome.
